  <file path="src/components/availability/calendar-dates.ts">
    export type CalendarView = "month" | "week";
    function daysSinceMonday(date: string): number {
      return (weekdayIndexOf(date) + 6) % 7;
    }
    function daysInMonth(year: number, month: number): number {
      return new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
    }
    export function visibleDates(view: CalendarView, anchor: string): string[] {
      const first = view === "week" ? anchor : `${anchor.slice(0, 8)}01`;
      const start = addDays(first, -daysSinceMonday(first));
      let end =
        view === "week"
          ? anchor
          : `${anchor.slice(0, 8)}${daysInMonth(Number(anchor.slice(0, 4)), Number(anchor.slice(5, 7)))}`;
      end = addDays(end, 6 - daysSinceMonday(end));
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = start; d <= end; d = addDays(d, 1)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function shiftAnchor(view: CalendarView, anchor: string, direction: 1 | -1): string {
      if (view === "week") return addDays(anchor, 7 * direction);
      const monthIndex = Number(anchor.slice(0, 4)) * 12 + Number(anchor.slice(5, 7)) - 1 + direction;
      const year = Math.floor(monthIndex / 12);
      const month = (monthIndex % 12) + 1;
      const day = Math.min(Number(anchor.slice(8, 10)), daysInMonth(year, month));
      return `${year}-${String(month).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(day).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/clock-minutes.ts">
    export function toClock(minute: number): string {
      const wrapped = minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }
    export function openFromClock(clock: string): number {
      const [hh = "0", mm = "0"] = clock.split(":");
      return Number(hh) * 60 + Number(mm);
    }
    export function closeFromClock(clock: string, opensAt: number): number {
      const minute = openFromClock(clock);
      return minute <= opensAt ? minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY : minute;
    }
    export function lastSeatingFromClock(clock: string, opensAt: number): number {
      const minute = openFromClock(clock);
      return minute < opensAt ? minute + MINUTES_PER_DAY : minute;
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/close-draft.ts">
    export type BookingChannel = "online" | "phone" | "waitlist";
    export type CloseWhat =
      | { readonly kind: "venue" }
      | { readonly kind: "service"; readonly serviceId: string }
      | { readonly kind: "booking"; readonly types: readonly BookingChannel[] };
    export type CloseWhen =
      | { readonly kind: "tonight" }
      | { readonly kind: "date"; readonly date: string }
      | { readonly kind: "range"; readonly from: string; readonly to: string }
      | {
          readonly kind: "repeats";
          readonly weekdays: readonly number[];
          readonly from: string;
          readonly to: string;
        }
      | { readonly kind: "until-reopen"; readonly from: string };
    export interface CloseForm {
      readonly what: CloseWhat;
      readonly when: CloseWhen;
      /** Minute of the service day the closure starts; `null` closes all day. */
      readonly fromMinute: number | null;
      readonly staffNote: string;
      readonly guestMessage: string;
    }
    export type CloseField = "what" | "when" | "guestMessage";
    export interface GroupChoice {
      readonly action?: ClosureAction;
      readonly acknowledged: boolean;
    }
    export type ChoiceMap = Readonly<Record<string, GroupChoice>>;
    export type OutcomeCounts = Readonly<Record<ClosureAction, number>>;
    interface Span {
      readonly startsOn: string;
      readonly endsOn: string | null;
      readonly weekdays?: readonly number[];
    }
    function spanOf(when: CloseWhen, today: string): Span {
      switch (when.kind) {
        case "tonight":
          return { startsOn: today, endsOn: today };
        case "date":
          return { startsOn: when.date, endsOn: when.date };
        case "range":
          return { startsOn: when.from, endsOn: when.to };
        case "repeats":
          return { startsOn: when.from, endsOn: when.to, weekdays: when.weekdays };
        case "until-reopen":
          return { startsOn: when.from, endsOn: null };
      }
    }
    function whatIsComplete(what: CloseWhat): boolean {
      if (what.kind === "service") return what.serviceId !== "";
      if (what.kind === "booking") return what.types.length > 0;
      return true;
    }
    function whenIsComplete(when: CloseWhen, today: string): boolean {
      const span = spanOf(when, today);
      if (span.startsOn === "") return false;
      if (span.endsOn !== null && (span.endsOn === "" || span.endsOn < span.startsOn)) return false;
      return span.weekdays === undefined || span.weekdays.length > 0;
    }
    export function validateClose(form: CloseForm, today: string): CloseField | null {
      if (!whatIsComplete(form.what)) return "what";
      if (!whenIsComplete(form.when, today)) return "when";
      if (form.guestMessage.trim().length > GUEST_MESSAGE_MAX_LENGTH) return "guestMessage";
      return null;
    }
    function targetOf(what: CloseWhat) {
      switch (what.kind) {
        case "venue":
          return { targetKind: "venue" as const };
        case "service":
          return { targetKind: "service" as const, venueServiceId: what.serviceId };
        case "booking":
          return { targetKind: "booking" as const, bookingTypes: [...what.types] };
      }
    }
    export function buildCloseRule(form: CloseForm, id: string, today: string): DateRule | null {
      if (validateClose(form, today) !== null) return null;
      const span = spanOf(form.when, today);
      const note = form.staffNote.trim();
      const message = form.guestMessage.trim();
      return {
        id,
        kind: "closure",
        ...targetOf(form.what),
        startsOn: span.startsOn,
        endsOn: span.endsOn,
        ...(span.weekdays ? { repeat: { version: 1 as const, weekdays: [...span.weekdays] } } : {}),
        window:
          form.fromMinute === null
            ? null
            : { version: 1 as const, from: form.fromMinute, to: END_OF_SERVICE_DAY },
        ...(note ? { staffNote: note } : {}),
        ...(message ? { guestMessage: message } : {}),
      };
    }
    export function actionsFor(kind: ClosureImpactKind): readonly ClosureAction[] {
      return kind === "shortened"
        ? ["cancel", "move", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"]
        : ["cancel", "keep_notify", "keep_silent"];
    }
    export function decisionsReady(groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[], choices: ChoiceMap): boolean {
      return groups.every((g) => {
        const choice = choices[g.groupKey];
        return choice?.action !== undefined && (choice.action !== "keep_silent" || choice.acknowledged);
      });
    }
    export function toDecisions(
      groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[],
      choices: ChoiceMap
    ): ClosureDecision[] {
      return groups.flatMap((g) => {
        const action = choices[g.groupKey]?.action;
        if (action === undefined) return [];
        return [
          action === "keep_silent"
            ? { groupKey: g.groupKey, action, acknowledged: true }
            : { groupKey: g.groupKey, action },
        ];
      });
    }
    export function outcomeCounts(
      groups: readonly ClosureImpactGroup[],
      choices: ChoiceMap
    ): OutcomeCounts {
      const counts: Record<ClosureAction, number> = {
        cancel: 0,
        move: 0,
        keep_notify: 0,
        keep_silent: 0,
      };
      for (const g of groups) {
        const action = choices[g.groupKey]?.action;
        if (action !== undefined) counts[action] += g.reservations.length;
      }
      return counts;
    }
    export function isUrgent(
      closure: { readonly startsOn: string; readonly fromMinute: number | null },
      today: string,
      nowMinute: number
    ): boolean {
      if (closure.startsOn < today) return true;
      const startMinute =
        (closure.startsOn === today ? 0 : MINUTES_PER_DAY) + (closure.fromMinute ?? 0);
      return startMinute - nowMinute <= URGENT_WITHIN_MINUTES;
    }
    export function activeOnlinePause(rules: readonly DateRule[], today: string): DateRule | null {
      return (
        rules.find(
          (r) =>
            r.kind === "closure" &&
            r.targetKind === "booking" &&
            (r.bookingTypes ?? []).includes("online") &&
            r.startsOn <= today &&
            (r.endsOn === null || r.endsOn === undefined || r.endsOn >= today)
        ) ?? null
      );
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/closure-band.ts">
    type Closure = AvailabilityDaySummary["closures"][number];
    export interface ClosureBandText {
      readonly key: string;
      /** Visible text: "Closed 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM". */
      readonly text: string;
      /** Spoken in a cell's name: "closed 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM". */
      readonly name: string;
    }
    export function minuteText(minute: number, t: TFunction, format: VenueFormat): string {
      const wrapped = minute % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      const time = format.formatLocalTime(`${hh}:${mm}`);
      return minute >= MINUTES_PER_DAY ? t("availability.calendar.nextDay", { time }) : time;
    }
    export function isWholeDay(closure: Pick<Closure, "from" | "to">): boolean {
      return closure.from === 0 && closure.to >= 2 * MINUTES_PER_DAY;
    }
    export function closureBandText(
      closure: Closure,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): ClosureBandText {
      if (isWholeDay(closure)) {
        return {
          key: closure.ruleId,
          text: t("availability.calendar.closedAllDay"),
          name: t("availability.calendar.closedAllDayName"),
        };
      }
      const values = {
        from: minuteText(closure.from, t, format),
        to: minuteText(closure.to, t, format),
      };
      return {
        key: closure.ruleId,
        text: t("availability.calendar.closedBand", values),
        name: t("availability.calendar.closedBandName", values),
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/day-summary.ts">
    export interface DayPresentation {
      readonly bands: readonly ClosureBandText[];
      /** "2 services", or `null` when the count is not worth showing. */
      readonly count: string | null;
      readonly onlineOff: boolean;
      /** The spoken details after the date: "Special hours, 2 services, closed 10:00 PM – 11:00 PM". */
      readonly accessibleDetails: string;
      /** The button's accessible name: "Friday, October 30: …". */
      readonly accessibleName: string;
    }
    export function presentDay(
      date: string,
      summary: AvailabilityDaySummary | undefined,
      detailed: boolean,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): DayPresentation {
      const bands = (summary?.closures ?? []).map((c) => closureBandText(c, t, format));
      const showCount = summary !== undefined && (detailed || summary.serviceCount >= 2);
      const count = showCount
        ? t("availability.calendar.services", { count: summary.serviceCount })
        : null;
      const onlineOff = summary !== undefined && !summary.bookingOpen.online;
    
      const parts = summary
        ? [
            summary.label,
            ...(count ? [count] : []),
            ...bands.map((b) => b.name),
            ...(onlineOff ? [t("availability.calendar.onlineOffName")] : []),
          ]
        : [t("availability.calendar.loadingDay")];
      const accessibleDetails = parts.join(", ");
      const fullDate = format.formatCalendarDate(date, {
        weekday: "long",
        month: "long",
        day: "numeric",
      });
      return {
        bands,
        count,
        onlineOff,
        accessibleDetails,
        accessibleName: t("availability.calendar.cellName", {
          date: fullDate,
          details: accessibleDetails,
        }),
      };
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/draft-changes.ts">
    export type EditScope =
      | { readonly kind: "date"; readonly date: string }
      /** Every weekday of `from`, from `from` until `until` (`null`: until changed again). */
      | { readonly kind: "weekday"; readonly from: string; readonly until: string | null }
      | { readonly kind: "schedule"; readonly scheduleId: string };
    export interface DraftService {
      /** React key; stable across edits. */
      readonly key: string;
      /** `null` for a service the venue has not had before; `name` then names it. */
      readonly venueServiceId: string | null;
      /** The stored schedule-service row this edits, in a schedule scope. */
      readonly scheduleServiceId: string | null;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
      readonly seating: Seating;
      readonly bookingTypes: readonly ("online" | "phone")[];
    }
    type SeedService = Pick<
      DraftService,
      "opensAt" | "lastSeatingAt" | "closesAt" | "seating" | "bookingTypes"
    >;
    export function seedServices(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      day: Pick<ResolvedDaySummary, "services">,
      scope: EditScope
    ): DraftService[] {
      if (scope.kind !== "schedule") {
        return day.services.map((s) => ({
          ...hoursOf(s),
          key: s.venueServiceId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          scheduleServiceId: null,
          name: s.name,
        }));
      }
      const names = new Map(config.venueServices.map((v) => [v.id, v.name]));
      return config.scheduleServices
        .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scope.scheduleId)
        .sort((a, b) => a.opensAt - b.opensAt)
        .map((s) => ({
          ...hoursOf(s),
          key: s.venueServiceId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
          scheduleServiceId: s.id,
          name: names.get(s.venueServiceId) ?? s.venueServiceId,
        }));
    }
    export function servicesEqual(a: readonly DraftService[], b: readonly DraftService[]): boolean {
      return comparable(a) === comparable(b);
    }
    interface BuildInput {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly scope: EditScope;
      readonly services: readonly DraftService[];
      /** Ids for rows this draft creates. */
      readonly makeId: () => string;
    }
    function ownDateRule(config: AvailabilityConfig, date: string): DateRule | undefined {
      return config.dateRules.find(
        (r) =>
          r.kind === "special_hours" &&
          r.targetKind === "venue" &&
          r.startsOn === date &&
          r.endsOn === date &&
          r.repeat == null &&
          r.window == null &&
          r.seriesId == null &&
          r.bookingTypes == null &&
          r.venueServiceId == null
      );
    }
    function specialHoursRule(base: Partial<DateRule>, id: string, services: SpecialHoursService[]) {
      return {
        ...base,
        id,
        kind: "special_hours",
        targetKind: "venue",
        startsOn: base.startsOn ?? "",
        payload: { version: 1, services },
      } as DateRule;
    }
    function scheduleServiceRows(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      scheduleId: string,
      services: readonly (DraftService & { venueServiceId: string })[],
      makeId: () => string
    ): { upsert: ScheduleService[]; removed: string[] } {
      const stored = config.scheduleServices.filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId);
      const kept = new Set(services.map((s) => s.venueServiceId));
      return {
        upsert: services.map((s) => ({
          ...hoursOf(s),
          bookingTypes: [...s.bookingTypes],
          id:
            s.scheduleServiceId ??
            stored.find((row) => row.venueServiceId === s.venueServiceId)?.id ??
            makeId(),
          scheduleId,
          venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
        })),
        removed: stored.filter((s) => !kept.has(s.venueServiceId)).map((s) => s.id),
      };
    }
    export function buildDraftChanges(input: BuildInput): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const { config, scope, makeId } = input;
      const nextPosition = Math.max(-1, ...config.venueServices.map((v) => v.position)) + 1;
      const created = input.services
        .filter((s) => s.venueServiceId === null)
        .map((s, i) => ({ id: makeId(), name: s.name, position: nextPosition + i }));
      let createdAt = 0;
      const services = input.services.map((s) => ({
        ...s,
        venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId ?? created[createdAt++]!.id,
      }));
      const venueServices = created.length > 0 ? { venueServices: created } : {};
    
      if (scope.kind === "schedule") {
        const { upsert, removed } = scheduleServiceRows(config, scope.scheduleId, services, makeId);
        return {
          upsert: { ...venueServices, scheduleServices: upsert },
          remove: removed.length > 0 ? { scheduleServices: removed } : {},
        };
      }
    
      const payload: SpecialHoursService[] = services.map((s) => ({
        ...hoursOf(s),
        bookingTypes: [...s.bookingTypes],
        venueServiceId: s.venueServiceId,
      }));
      const own = scope.kind === "date" ? ownDateRule(config, scope.date) : undefined;
      const rule =
        scope.kind === "date"
          ? specialHoursRule(
              own ?? { startsOn: scope.date, endsOn: scope.date },
              own?.id ?? makeId(),
              payload
            )
          : specialHoursRule(
              {
                startsOn: scope.from,
                endsOn: scope.until,
                repeat: { version: 1, weekdays: [weekdayIndexOf(scope.from)] },
              },
              makeId(),
              payload
            );
      return { upsert: { ...venueServices, dateRules: [rule] }, remove: {} };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/quick-setup-draft.ts">
    export interface ServiceDraft {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name: string;
      readonly opens: string | null;
      readonly lastSeating: string | null;
      readonly closes: string | null;
      /** While true, last seating follows close minus {@link LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES}. */
      readonly lastSeatingLinked: boolean;
    }
    export interface QuickSetupDraft {
      readonly services: readonly ServiceDraft[];
      /** Stored weekday indexes, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. */
      readonly days: readonly number[];
    }
    export const LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES = 45;
    export const WEEK_DISPLAY_ORDER: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 0];
    export const WEEKDAY_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
    export const WEEKEND_SHORTCUT: readonly number[] = [6, 0];
    export const SERVICE_PRESETS = {
      lunch: { opens: "11:30", closes: "14:30" },
      brunch: { opens: "10:00", closes: "14:00" },
      dinner: { opens: "17:00", closes: "22:00" },
      late: { opens: "22:00", closes: "01:00" },
    } as const;
    export type ServicePresetId = keyof typeof SERVICE_PRESETS;
    export const SERVICE_PRESET_IDS = Object.keys(SERVICE_PRESETS) as ServicePresetId[];
    export function emptyService(id: string): ServiceDraft {
      return { id, name: "", opens: null, lastSeating: null, closes: null, lastSeatingLinked: true };
    }
    export function emptyDraft(firstServiceId: string): QuickSetupDraft {
      return { services: [emptyService(firstServiceId)], days: [] };
    }
    function toMinutes(hhmm: string): number {
      const [h = 0, m = 0] = hhmm.split(":").map(Number);
      return h * 60 + m;
    }
    export function toClock(minutes: number): string {
      const wrapped = ((minutes % MINUTES_PER_DAY) + MINUTES_PER_DAY) % MINUTES_PER_DAY;
      const hh = String(Math.floor(wrapped / 60)).padStart(2, "0");
      const mm = String(wrapped % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${hh}:${mm}`;
    }
    export function autoLastSeating(closes: string): string {
      return toClock(toMinutes(closes) - LAST_SEATING_LEAD_MINUTES);
    }
    export function applyPreset(service: ServiceDraft, preset: ServicePresetId, name: string) {
      const { opens, closes } = SERVICE_PRESETS[preset];
      return {
        ...service,
        name,
        opens,
        closes,
        lastSeating: autoLastSeating(closes),
        lastSeatingLinked: true,
      };
    }
    export function setServiceTime(
      service: ServiceDraft,
      field: "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes",
      value: string | null
    ): ServiceDraft {
      if (field === "lastSeating") return { ...service, lastSeating: value, lastSeatingLinked: false };
      if (field === "closes" && service.lastSeatingLinked) {
        return {
          ...service,
          closes: value,
          lastSeating: value === null ? null : autoLastSeating(value),
        };
      }
      return { ...service, [field]: value };
    }
    export function replaceService(draft: QuickSetupDraft, next: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupDraft {
      return { ...draft, services: draft.services.map((s) => (s.id === next.id ? next : s)) };
    }
    export function toggleDay(draft: QuickSetupDraft, day: number): QuickSetupDraft {
      const days = draft.days.includes(day)
        ? draft.days.filter((d) => d !== day)
        : [...draft.days, day];
      return { ...draft, days };
    }
    export type QuickSetupField = "name" | "opens" | "lastSeating" | "closes";
    export type QuickSetupIssueCode =
      | "name_required"
      | "time_required"
      | "close_after_open"
      | "last_seating_after_close"
      | "last_seating_before_open"
      | "overlap"
      | "days_required";
    export interface QuickSetupIssue {
      /** `null` for the whole card (days). */
      readonly serviceId: string | null;
      readonly field: QuickSetupField | "days";
      readonly code: QuickSetupIssueCode;
    }
    interface ServiceMinutes {
      readonly opensAt: number;
      readonly lastSeatingAt: number;
      readonly closesAt: number;
    }
    function minutesOf(service: ServiceDraft): ServiceMinutes | null {
      if (service.opens === null || service.lastSeating === null || service.closes === null)
        return null;
      const opensAt = toMinutes(service.opens);
      const afterOpen = (hhmm: string, strict: boolean) => {
        const m = toMinutes(hhmm);
        return strict
          ? m <= opensAt
            ? m + MINUTES_PER_DAY
            : m
          : m < opensAt
            ? m + MINUTES_PER_DAY
            : m;
      };
      return {
        opensAt,
        closesAt: afterOpen(service.closes, true),
        lastSeatingAt: afterOpen(service.lastSeating, false),
      };
    }
    function completenessIssues(service: ServiceDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const missing = TIME_FIELDS.filter(([key]) => service[key] === null).map(
        ([, field]): QuickSetupIssue => ({
          serviceId: service.id,
          field,
          code: "time_required",
        })
      );
      const unnamed: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        service.name.trim() === ""
          ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "name", code: "name_required" }]
          : [];
      return [...unnamed, ...missing];
    }
    function orderIssues(service: ServiceDraft, m: ServiceMinutes): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const at = (field: QuickSetupField, code: QuickSetupIssueCode): QuickSetupIssue => ({
        serviceId: service.id,
        field,
        code,
      });
      if (service.opens === service.closes) return [at("closes", "close_after_open")];
      return m.lastSeatingAt > m.closesAt ? [at("lastSeating", "last_seating_after_close")] : [];
    }
    export function validateDraft(draft: QuickSetupDraft): QuickSetupIssue[] {
      const perService = draft.services.flatMap((service) => {
        const missing = completenessIssues(service);
        const minutes = minutesOf(service);
        return missing.length > 0 || minutes === null ? missing : orderIssues(service, minutes);
      });
      const daysIssue: QuickSetupIssue[] =
        draft.days.length === 0 ? [{ serviceId: null, field: "days", code: "days_required" }] : [];
      if (perService.length > 0) return [...perService, ...daysIssue];
    
      const config = draftToConfig(draft, () => "check");
      const overlaps = validateConfig(config)
        .filter((issue) => issue.code === "overlap")
        .flatMap((issue): QuickSetupIssue[] => {
          const index = Number(/scheduleServices\[(\d+)\]/.exec(issue.path)?.[1]);
          const service = draft.services[index];
          return service ? [{ serviceId: service.id, field: "opens", code: "overlap" }] : [];
        });
      return [...overlaps, ...daysIssue];
    }
    export function draftToConfig(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      newId: () => string,
      existing?: { regularScheduleId?: string; venueServiceIds?: Readonly<Record<string, string>> }
    ): AvailabilityConfig {
      const scheduleId = existing?.regularScheduleId ?? newId();
      const schedule: Schedule = {
        id: scheduleId,
        name: "Regular week",
        kind: "regular",
        isRegular: true,
      };
      const venueServices: VenueService[] = [];
      const scheduleServices: ScheduleService[] = [];
      draft.services.forEach((service, position) => {
        const m = minutesOf(service);
        if (m === null) return;
        const name = service.name.trim();
        const venueServiceId = existing?.venueServiceIds?.[name.toLowerCase()] ?? newId();
        venueServices.push({ id: venueServiceId, name, position });
        scheduleServices.push({
          id: newId(),
          scheduleId,
          venueServiceId,
          ...m,
          seating: { version: 1, interval: SEATING_INTERVAL_MINUTES },
          bookingTypes: ["online", "phone"],
        });
      });
      const assignment: ScheduleAssignment = {
        id: newId(),
        scheduleId,
        weekdays: [...draft.days].sort((a, b) => a - b),
        precedence: 0,
      };
      return {
        schedules: [schedule],
        venueServices,
        scheduleServices,
        assignments: [assignment],
        dateRules: [],
      };
    }
    export function draftToChanges(
      draft: QuickSetupDraft,
      stored: AvailabilityConfig,
      newId: () => string
    ): AvailabilityConfigChanges {
      const regular = stored.schedules.find((s) => s.isRegular);
      const venueServiceIds = Object.fromEntries(
        stored.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt).map((s) => [s.name.toLowerCase(), s.id])
      );
      const next = draftToConfig(draft, newId, {
        ...(regular ? { regularScheduleId: regular.id } : {}),
        venueServiceIds,
      });
      const scheduleId = next.schedules[0]?.id;
      const storedServiceIds = new Set(stored.venueServices.map((s) => s.id));
      return {
        upsert: {
          schedules: next.schedules,
          venueServices: next.venueServices.filter((s) => !storedServiceIds.has(s.id)),
          scheduleServices: next.scheduleServices,
          assignments: next.assignments,
        },
        remove: {
          scheduleServices: stored.scheduleServices
            .filter((s) => s.scheduleId === scheduleId)
            .map((s) => s.id),
          assignments: stored.assignments.filter((a) => a.scheduleId === scheduleId).map((a) => a.id),
        },
      };
    }
    export function draftToLegacyHours(draft: QuickSetupDraft): OperatingHours {
      const projected = projectLegacyOperatingHours(draftToConfig(draft, () => "wizard"));
      const hours: OperatingHours = {};
      for (const [day, value] of Object.entries(projected)) {
        if (!value.closed)
          hours[day as keyof OperatingHours] = { open: value.open, close: value.close };
      }
      return hours;
    }
    export function draftFromLegacyHours(hours: OperatingHours, serviceId: string): QuickSetupDraft {
      const order = [
        "sunday",
        "monday",
        "tuesday",
        "wednesday",
        "thursday",
        "friday",
        "saturday",
      ] as const;
      const open = order.flatMap((day, index) => {
        const value = hours[day];
        return value && !value.closed ? [{ index, value }] : [];
      });
      const first = open[0]?.value;
      if (!first) return emptyDraft(serviceId);
      return {
        services: [
          {
            ...emptyService(serviceId),
            opens: first.open,
            closes: first.close,
            lastSeating: autoLastSeating(first.close),
          },
        ],
        days: open.map((o) => o.index),
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/components/availability/removal-diff.ts">
    type Channel = keyof BookingOpen;
    export type RemovalChange =
      | { kind: "serviceOpens"; name: string; opensAt: number; closesAt: number }
      | { kind: "serviceCloses"; name: string }
      | { kind: "opensAtChanges"; name: string; minute: number }
      | { kind: "closesAtChanges"; name: string; minute: number; later: boolean }
      | { kind: "lastSeatingChanges"; name: string; minute: number }
      | { kind: "closureLifted"; closure: ResolvedClosure; serviceName?: string }
      | { kind: "closureApplies"; closure: ResolvedClosure }
      | { kind: "bookingOn"; channel: Channel }
      | { kind: "bookingOff"; channel: Channel }
      | { kind: "pacingLifted" }
      | { kind: "pacingSet"; covers: number };
    function serviceChanges(
      current: readonly ResolvedService[],
      removed: readonly ResolvedService[]
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      const now = new Map(current.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const then = new Map(removed.map((s) => [s.venueServiceId, s]));
      const opening = removed
        .filter((s) => !now.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .map((s): RemovalChange => ({
          kind: "serviceOpens",
          name: s.name,
          opensAt: s.opensAt,
          closesAt: s.closesAt,
        }));
      const closing = current
        .filter((s) => !then.has(s.venueServiceId))
        .map((s): RemovalChange => ({ kind: "serviceCloses", name: s.name }));
      const adjusted = removed.flatMap((after): RemovalChange[] => {
        const before = now.get(after.venueServiceId);
        if (!before) return [];
        return [
          ...(before.opensAt !== after.opensAt
            ? [{ kind: "opensAtChanges" as const, name: after.name, minute: after.opensAt }]
            : []),
          ...(before.closesAt !== after.closesAt
            ? [
                {
                  kind: "closesAtChanges" as const,
                  name: after.name,
                  minute: after.closesAt,
                  later: after.closesAt > before.closesAt,
                },
              ]
            : []),
          ...(before.lastSeatingAt !== after.lastSeatingAt
            ? [
                {
                  kind: "lastSeatingChanges" as const,
                  name: after.name,
                  minute: after.lastSeatingAt,
                },
              ]
            : []),
        ];
      });
      return [...opening, ...closing, ...adjusted];
    }
    function closureChanges(
      current: readonly ResolvedClosure[],
      removed: readonly ResolvedClosure[],
      services: readonly ResolvedService[]
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      const nameOf = (c: ResolvedClosure) =>
        c.targetKind === "service"
          ? services.find((s) => s.venueServiceId === c.venueServiceId)?.name
          : undefined;
      // A whole-day closure of services or booking channels already shows up as those changes.
      const worthSaying = (c: ResolvedClosure) => !isWholeDay(c) || c.targetKind === "tables";
      return [
        ...current
          .filter((c) => !removed.some((r) => sameClosure(r, c)) && worthSaying(c))
          .map((closure): RemovalChange => ({
            kind: "closureLifted",
            closure,
            serviceName: nameOf(closure),
          })),
        ...removed
          .filter((c) => !current.some((r) => sameClosure(r, c)) && worthSaying(c))
          .map((closure): RemovalChange => ({ kind: "closureApplies", closure })),
      ];
    }
    function bookingChanges(current: BookingOpen, removed: BookingOpen): RemovalChange[] {
      return CHANNELS.flatMap((channel): RemovalChange[] => {
        if (current[channel] === removed[channel]) return [];
        return [{ kind: removed[channel] ? "bookingOn" : "bookingOff", channel }];
      });
    }
    function pacingChanges(current: ResolvedDaySummary, removed: ResolvedDaySummary): RemovalChange[] {
      if (current.pacingCovers === removed.pacingCovers) return [];
      return removed.pacingCovers === undefined
        ? [{ kind: "pacingLifted" }]
        : [{ kind: "pacingSet", covers: removed.pacingCovers }];
    }
    export function diffRemoval(
      current: ResolvedDaySummary,
      removed: ResolvedDaySummary
    ): RemovalChange[] {
      return [
        ...serviceChanges(current.services, removed.services),
        ...closureChanges(current.closures, removed.closures, current.services),
        ...bookingChanges(current.bookingOpen, removed.bookingOpen),
        ...pacingChanges(current, removed),
      ];
    }
    function liftedText(
      change: Extract<RemovalChange, { kind: "closureLifted" }>,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const { closure } = change;
      if (isWholeDay(closure)) return t("availability.drawer.removal.reopensAllDay");
      const range = {
        from: minuteText(closure.from, t, format),
        to: minuteText(closure.to, t, format),
      };
      if (closure.targetKind === "booking") {
        const channels = (closure.bookingTypes ?? []).map((c) =>
          t(`availability.drawer.removal.channel.${c}`)
        );
        return t("availability.drawer.removal.channelBackOn", {
          ...range,
          channels: new Intl.ListFormat(format.locale, { type: "conjunction" }).format(channels),
        });
      }
      if (closure.targetKind === "service" && change.serviceName) {
        return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceReopens", { ...range, name: change.serviceName });
      }
      return t("availability.drawer.removal.reopens", range);
    }
    export function removalChangeText(
      change: RemovalChange,
      t: TFunction,
      format: VenueFormat
    ): string {
      const at = (minute: number) => minuteText(minute, t, format);
      switch (change.kind) {
        case "serviceOpens":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceOpens", {
            name: change.name,
            from: at(change.opensAt),
            to: at(change.closesAt),
          });
        case "serviceCloses":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.serviceCloses", { name: change.name });
        case "opensAtChanges":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.opensAt", {
            name: change.name,
            time: at(change.minute),
          });
        case "closesAtChanges":
          return t(
            change.later
              ? "availability.drawer.removal.closesLater"
              : "availability.drawer.removal.closesEarlier",
            { name: change.name, time: at(change.minute) }
          );
        case "lastSeatingChanges":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.lastSeating", {
            name: change.name,
            time: at(change.minute),
          });
        case "closureLifted":
          return liftedText(change, t, format);
        case "closureApplies":
          return isWholeDay(change.closure)
            ? t("availability.calendar.closedAllDayName")
            : t("availability.drawer.removal.closes", {
                from: at(change.closure.from),
                to: at(change.closure.to),
              });
        case "bookingOn":
          return t(`availability.drawer.removal.bookingOn.${change.channel}`);
        case "bookingOff":
          return t(`availability.drawer.removal.bookingOff.${change.channel}`);
        case "pacingLifted":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.pacingLifted");
        case "pacingSet":
          return t("availability.drawer.removal.pacingSet", { covers: change.covers });
      }
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/scope-dates.ts">
    export const SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS = 366;
    interface ScopeContext {
      readonly config: AvailabilityConfig;
      readonly timezone: string;
      /** Today on the venue clock. */
      readonly today: string;
    }
    function eachDate(from: string, to: string, step: number): string[] {
      const dates: string[] = [];
      for (let d = from; d <= to; d = addDays(d, step)) dates.push(d);
      return dates;
    }
    export function scopeDates(scope: EditScope, context: ScopeContext): string[] {
      if (scope.kind === "date") return [scope.date];
      if (scope.kind === "weekday") {
        const horizon = addDays(scope.from, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1);
        const last = scope.until !== null && scope.until < horizon ? scope.until : horizon;
        return eachDate(scope.from, last, 7);
      }
      const week = {
        timezone: context.timezone,
        config: { ...context.config, dateRules: [] },
      };
      return eachDate(context.today, addDays(context.today, SCOPE_HORIZON_DAYS - 1), 1).filter(
        (d) => resolveDay(week, d).scheduleId === scope.scheduleId
      );
    }
    function coversDate(rule: DateRule, date: string): boolean {
      return (
        rule.startsOn <= date &&
        (rule.endsOn == null || date <= rule.endsOn) &&
        (rule.repeat == null || rule.repeat.weekdays.includes(weekdayIndexOf(date)))
      );
    }
    export function ownChangeDates(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      dates: readonly string[],
      ignoreRuleId: string | null
    ): string[] {
      const skipped = new Set(
        config.dateRules.filter((r) => r.kind === "skip").map((r) => `${r.seriesId}@${r.startsOn}`)
      );
      const rules = config.dateRules.filter((r) => isHoursRule(r) && r.id !== ignoreRuleId);
      return dates.filter((date) =>
        rules.some((rule) => coversDate(rule, date) && !skipped.has(`${rule.id}@${date}`))
      );
    }

  <file path="src/components/availability/use-discard-guard.ts">
    export function useDiscardGuard<T>(apply: (next: T) => void) {
      const [dirty, setDirty] = useState(false);
      const [pending, setPending] = useState<{ readonly next: T } | null>(null);
    
      /** Moves on now, with the draft gone: after a save, or once it has been thrown away. */
      const release = (next: T) => {
        setDirty(false);
        setPending(null);
        apply(next);
      };
    
      return {
        dirty,
        setDirty,
        pending,
        request: (next: T) => (dirty ? setPending({ next }) : apply(next)),
        release,
        keepEditing: () => setPending(null),
        confirmDiscard: () => {
          if (pending) release(pending.next);
        },
      };
    }
  </file>

  <file path="src/components/booking-widget/effectiveDepositPolicy.ts">
    export interface EffectiveDepositPolicyParams {
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null;
      venueSlug: string | undefined;
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined;
      guestIsRisky: boolean;
    }
    export function effectiveDepositPolicy({
      depositConfig,
      venueSlug,
      stripePublishableKey,
      guestIsRisky,
    }: EffectiveDepositPolicyParams): DepositConfig | null {
      if (!venueSlug || !stripePublishableKey || !depositConfig) return null;
      if (depositConfig.enabled) return depositConfig;
      return guestIsRisky ? depositConfig : null;
    }
    export function guestRiskMatters(
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null,
      venueSlug: string | undefined,
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return !depositConfig?.enabled && Boolean(venueSlug) && Boolean(stripePublishableKey);
    }
    export function provisionalDepositRequired(
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null,
      venueSlug: string | undefined,
      stripePublishableKey: string | undefined
    ): boolean {
      return (
        effectiveDepositPolicy({
          depositConfig,
          venueSlug,
          stripePublishableKey,
          guestIsRisky: false,
        }) !== null
      );
    }

    type FreeWindow = Extract<CancellationPolicyDescription, { kind: "free-window" }>;
    export function describeDepositCancellation(
      config: DepositConfig | null,
      partySize: number
    ): FreeWindow | null {
      if (!config || config.freeCancellationHours == null) return null;
      const description = describeCancellationPolicy({
        depositAmountCents: quoteDeposit(config, partySize),
        freeCancellationHours: config.freeCancellationHours,
        lateCancellationFeePercent: config.lateCancellationFeePercent,
        noShowFeePercent: config.noShowFeePercent,
      });
      return description.kind === "free-window" ? description : null;
    }
    export function useDepositCancellationTerms(
      config: DepositConfig | null,
      partySize: number
    ): string | null {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      const { formatMoney } = useVenueFormat({
        ianaTimezone: "",
        currencyCode: config?.currency ?? "usd",
      });
      const terms = describeDepositCancellation(config, partySize);
      if (!terms) return null;
      return t("bookingWidget.cancellationTerms", {
        count: terms.freeHours,
        lateFeePercent: terms.lateFeePercent,
        lateFee: formatMoney(terms.lateFeeAmountCents),
        noShowFeePercent: terms.noShowFeePercent,
        noShowFee: formatMoney(terms.noShowFeeAmountCents),
      });
    }

    export function hasOperatingHours(operatingHours: OperatingHours | null | undefined): boolean {
      if (!operatingHours) return false;
      return DAYS.some((day) => {
        const schedule = operatingHours[day];
        return schedule != null && schedule.closed !== true;
      });
    }

  <file path="src/components/booking-widget/useBookingFlow.ts">
    export type BookingStep =
      | "date-party"
      | "time-slot"
      | "guest-details"
      | "payment"
      | "confirmation"
      | "waitlist-join"
      | "waitlist-confirmation";
    export interface WaitlistResult {
      statusToken: string;
      position: number;
      estimatedWaitMinutes: number | null;
    }
    export interface ClosedMidBooking {
      /** The venue's guest message for the closure. */
      message: string;
      /** The time the guest had chosen, so alternatives can be offered near it. */
      lostTime: string;
    }
    export interface SlotListing {
      slots: TimeSlot[];
      closure?: { message: string };
      bookingPaused?: BookingPaused;
    }
    export interface BookingFlowData {
      selectedDate: string | null;
      selectedEndDate: string | null;
      partySize: number;
      slots: TimeSlot[];
      selectedSlot: TimeSlot | null;
      slotsLoading: boolean;
      slotsError: string | null;
      /**
       * Closed dates learned from listings, date to guest message. The public
       * API has no range listing, so the date step only knows a date is closed
       * after a listing for it has come back.
       */
      closures: Record<string, string>;
      /** Online booking is paused venue-wide; from the latest listing. */
      bookingPaused: BookingPaused | null;
      closedMidBooking: ClosedMidBooking | null;
      hold: ReservationHold | null;
      holdLoading: boolean;
      holdError: string | null;
      reservation: Reservation | null;
      /**
       * Self-service manage/cancel token returned alongside the confirmed
       * reservation — threaded through to ConfirmationView so guests get a
       * working "Cancel Reservation" link instead of a dead-end button (#4978).
       */
      manageToken: string | null;
      confirmLoading: boolean;
      confirmError: string | null;
      depositConfig: DepositConfig | null;
      /**
       * Whether a deposit is required for this flow. Before confirmation this is
       * a provisional guess derived from the venue's general policy alone (risk
       * is not yet known); `CONFIRM_SUCCESS_WITH_DEPOSIT` / `_NO_DEPOSIT`
       * overwrite it with the final, risk-aware outcome — the single source of
       * truth the step set and indicator derive from.
       */
      depositRequired: boolean;
      depositPaymentIntentId: string | null;
      waitlistResult: WaitlistResult | null;
      /**
       * The venue's full public config (name + ianaTimezone, among other fields),
       * fetched once alongside the deposit config when `venueSlug` is present.
       * Threaded down to `ConfirmationView` for the "Add to calendar" actions —
       * null until the fetch resolves, or if `venueSlug` was never provided.
       */
      venueConfig: PublicVenueConfig | null;
      /**
       * The guest details form's fields, lifted here (not owned by
       * `GuestDetailsForm`'s local state) so `EXPIRE_HOLD` doesn't wipe what the
       * guest already typed — the form unmounts when the step falls back to
       * "time-slot", but this survives and re-seeds the form once a new hold
       * succeeds.
       */
      guestDetails: GuestDetails;
    }
    interface BookingFlowState {
      step: BookingStep;
      data: BookingFlowData;
    }
    type BookingFlowAction =
      | { type: "SET_DATE"; date: string | null }
      | { type: "SET_END_DATE"; date: string | null }
      | { type: "SET_PARTY_SIZE"; size: number }
      | { type: "GO_TO_TIME_SLOT" }
      | { type: "GO_TO_DATE_PARTY" }
      | { type: "SET_SLOTS"; listing: SlotListing }
      | { type: "CLOSED_MID_BOOKING"; message: string }
      | { type: "SET_CLOSED_DATES"; closures: Record<string, string> }
      | { type: "SET_SLOTS_ERROR"; error: string }
      | { type: "HOLD_START"; slot: TimeSlot }
      | { type: "HOLD_SUCCESS"; hold: ReservationHold; slot: TimeSlot }
      | { type: "HOLD_ERROR"; error: string }
      | { type: "CONFIRM_START" }
      | { type: "CONFIRM_SUCCESS_NO_DEPOSIT"; reservation: Reservation; manageToken: string | null }
      | { type: "CONFIRM_SUCCESS_WITH_DEPOSIT"; reservation: Reservation; manageToken: string | null }
      | { type: "CONFIRM_ERROR"; error: string }
      | { type: "DEPOSIT_SUCCESS"; paymentIntentId: string }
      | { type: "EXPIRE_HOLD"; error: string }
      | { type: "RESET"; selectedDate: string }
      | { type: "SET_DEPOSIT_CONFIG"; config: DepositConfig | null; depositRequired: boolean }
      | { type: "SET_VENUE_CONFIG"; config: PublicVenueConfig }
      | { type: "GO_TO_WAITLIST_JOIN" }
      | { type: "WAITLIST_JOINED"; result: WaitlistResult }
      | { type: "SET_GUEST_DETAILS"; details: GuestDetails };
    function createInitialState(venueTimezone?: string): BookingFlowState {
      return {
        step: "date-party",
        data: { ...INITIAL_DATA, selectedDate: venueDate(new Date(), venueTimezone) },
      };
    }
    export const MISSING_VENUE_SLUG_ERROR = enUS.bookingWidget.errors.missingVenueSlug;
    export const STEP_KEYS_NO_DEPOSIT: BookingStep[] = ["date-party", "time-slot", "guest-details"];
    export const STEP_KEYS_WITH_DEPOSIT: BookingStep[] = [
      "date-party",
      "time-slot",
      "guest-details",
      "payment",
    ];
    export function deriveStepKeys(depositRequired: boolean): BookingStep[] {
      return depositRequired ? STEP_KEYS_WITH_DEPOSIT : STEP_KEYS_NO_DEPOSIT;
    }
    function outsideAvailabilityMessage(error: unknown): string | null {
      if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null || !("problemDetails" in error)) return null;
      const problem = (
        error as { problemDetails: { code?: unknown; reason?: unknown; detail?: unknown } }
      ).problemDetails;
      if (problem.code !== "outside-availability") return null;
      // Only a closed venue makes "this time just closed" true; a blocked table or
      // a closed booking type is an ordinary refusal and keeps its own message.
      if (!CLOSURE_REASONS.has(String(problem.reason))) return null;
      return typeof problem.detail === "string" ? problem.detail : "";
    }
    function reducer(state: BookingFlowState, action: BookingFlowAction): BookingFlowState {
      switch (action.type) {
        case "SET_DATE":
          return { ...state, data: { ...state.data, selectedDate: action.date } };
    
        case "SET_END_DATE":
          return { ...state, data: { ...state.data, selectedEndDate: action.date } };
    
        case "SET_PARTY_SIZE":
          return { ...state, data: { ...state.data, partySize: action.size } };
    
        case "GO_TO_TIME_SLOT":
          return {
            step: "time-slot",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              selectedSlot: null,
              hold: null,
              slotsLoading: true,
              slotsError: null,
              holdError: null,
              closedMidBooking: null,
            },
          };
    
        case "GO_TO_DATE_PARTY":
          return {
            step: "date-party",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              selectedSlot: null,
              slots: [],
              hold: null,
              closedMidBooking: null,
            },
          };
    
        case "SET_SLOTS": {
          const { listing } = action;
          const date = state.data.selectedDate;
          const { [date ?? ""]: _previous, ...otherClosures } = state.data.closures;
          const closures =
            date && listing.closure
              ? { ...otherClosures, [date]: listing.closure.message }
              : otherClosures;
          return {
            ...state,
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              slots: listing.slots,
              closures,
              bookingPaused: listing.bookingPaused ?? null,
              slotsLoading: false,
              slotsError: null,
            },
          };
        }
    
        case "SET_CLOSED_DATES":
          // What a listing already learned about a date wins over the upfront list.
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, closures: { ...action.closures, ...state.data.closures } },
          };
    
        case "CLOSED_MID_BOOKING":
          return {
            step: "time-slot",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              hold: null,
              selectedSlot: null,
              confirmLoading: false,
              confirmError: null,
              slotsLoading: true,
              closedMidBooking: {
                message: action.message,
                lostTime: state.data.selectedSlot?.time ?? "",
              },
            },
          };
    
        case "SET_SLOTS_ERROR":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, slotsError: action.error, slotsLoading: false },
          };
    
        case "HOLD_START":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, holdLoading: true, holdError: null },
          };
    
        case "HOLD_SUCCESS":
          return {
            step: "guest-details",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              hold: action.hold,
              selectedSlot: action.slot,
              holdLoading: false,
              holdError: null,
            },
          };
    
        case "HOLD_ERROR":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, holdError: action.error, holdLoading: false },
          };
    
        case "CONFIRM_START":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, confirmLoading: true, confirmError: null },
          };
    
        case "CONFIRM_SUCCESS_NO_DEPOSIT":
          return {
            step: "confirmation",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              // The server turned the hold into this reservation, so it is consumed:
              // clearing it keeps the expiry timer (and onHoldChange) from acting on
              // a hold that no longer protects anything — payment and confirmation
              // both come after creation.
              hold: null,
              reservation: action.reservation,
              manageToken: action.manageToken,
              confirmLoading: false,
              confirmError: null,
              depositRequired: false,
            },
          };
    
        case "CONFIRM_SUCCESS_WITH_DEPOSIT":
          return {
            step: "payment",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              // The server turned the hold into this reservation, so it is consumed:
              // clearing it keeps the expiry timer (and onHoldChange) from acting on
              // a hold that no longer protects anything — payment and confirmation
              // both come after creation.
              hold: null,
              reservation: action.reservation,
              manageToken: action.manageToken,
              confirmLoading: false,
              confirmError: null,
              depositRequired: true,
            },
          };
    
        case "CONFIRM_ERROR":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, confirmError: action.error, confirmLoading: false },
          };
    
        case "DEPOSIT_SUCCESS":
          return {
            step: "confirmation",
            data: { ...state.data, depositPaymentIntentId: action.paymentIntentId },
          };
    
        case "EXPIRE_HOLD":
          return {
            step: "time-slot",
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              hold: null,
              holdError: action.error,
              slotsLoading: true,
            },
          };
    
        case "RESET":
          return { step: "date-party", data: { ...INITIAL_DATA, selectedDate: action.selectedDate } };
    
        case "SET_DEPOSIT_CONFIG":
          // Provisional pre-confirm guess (risk isn't known yet); CONFIRM_SUCCESS_*
          // overwrites this with the final, risk-aware outcome. `depositRequired`
          // is computed by the caller via `provisionalDepositRequired` — the
          // shared deposit-verdict module — so it can never independently drift
          // from it, and it agrees with the confirm-time verdict on whether
          // Stripe is configured for this venue.
          return {
            ...state,
            data: {
              ...state.data,
              depositConfig: action.config,
              depositRequired: action.depositRequired,
            },
          };
    
        case "SET_VENUE_CONFIG":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, venueConfig: action.config },
          };
    
        case "GO_TO_WAITLIST_JOIN":
          return { ...state, step: "waitlist-join" };
    
        case "WAITLIST_JOINED":
          return {
            step: "waitlist-confirmation",
            data: { ...state.data, waitlistResult: action.result },
          };
    
        case "SET_GUEST_DETAILS":
          return {
            ...state,
            data: { ...state.data, guestDetails: action.details },
          };
    
        default:
          return state;
      }
    }
    export interface BookingFlowActions {
      setSelectedDate: (date: string | null) => void;
      setSelectedEndDate: (date: string | null) => void;
      setPartySize: (size: number) => void;
      goToTimeSlot: () => void;
      goToDateParty: () => void;
      selectSlotAndHold: (slot: TimeSlot) => Promise<void>;
      confirmReservation: (details: GuestDetails) => Promise<void>;
      handleDepositSuccess: (paymentIntentId: string) => void;
      resetFlow: () => void;
      goToWaitlistJoin: () => void;
      handleWaitlistJoined: (result: WaitlistResult) => void;
      setGuestDetails: (details: GuestDetails) => void;
    }
    export interface BookingFlowResult {
      state: BookingStep;
      data: BookingFlowData;
      actions: BookingFlowActions;
      /** The step set for this flow, derived from `data.depositRequired` — the single source of truth. */
      stepKeys: BookingStep[];
      /** Index of the current step within `stepKeys`; always valid since both step sets share it. */
      currentStepIndex: number;
    }
    export interface UseBookingFlowDeps {
      /** The public (unauthenticated) api client — the injected seam for the whole flow's effects. */
      api: BookingWidgetApiClient;
      /**
       * Slug backing every public endpoint this flow calls — venue config, guest
       * risk, and (since #4487) the whole hold lifecycle, which now goes through
       * `/public/v1/venues/:slug/holds` instead of the authenticated staff hold
       * routes. Omitting it skips deposit config and risk gating as before, and
       * additionally makes holding impossible: `selectSlotAndHold` reports an
       * error rather than calling a route that would 401.
       */
      venueSlug?: string;
      /** Present when the venue's Stripe integration is configured; required (with venueSlug) for a deposit to ever be required. */
      stripePublishableKey?: string;
      /**
       * Notified whenever the flow's active (unconfirmed) hold changes —
       * created, released, expired, or consumed by a successful confirm. Lets
       * the embedding page track the hold so it can release it if the guest
       * closes the tab before confirming (#4978). `sessionId` travels alongside
       * the hold id because releasing a hold requires the same `x-session-id`
       * used to create it, which lives inside `api.holds`, not component state.
       */
      onHoldChange?: (info: { holdId: string; sessionId: string | null } | null) => void;
      /**
       * IANA timezone the venue operates in — used to default `selectedDate` to
       * "today" on the venue's clock rather than a UTC midnight boundary
       * (#4981). Omit only when unknown; falls back to the device clock.
       */
      venueTimezone?: string;
    }
    export function useBookingFlow({
      api,
      venueSlug,
      stripePublishableKey,
      onHoldChange,
      venueTimezone,
    }: UseBookingFlowDeps): BookingFlowResult {
      const [flowState, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, venueTimezone, createInitialState);
      // The i18n instance is stable, so callbacks reading it don't churn on a
      // language switch; each message is resolved in the locale active when it fires.
      const { i18n } = useTranslation();
    
      // Ref pattern (see hospitality app conventions) — onHoldChange is commonly
      // passed as a fresh inline arrow on every render; reading it through a ref
      // keeps the notify-effect below from re-firing on unrelated re-renders.
      const onHoldChangeRef = useRef(onHoldChange);
      useEffect(() => {
        onHoldChangeRef.current = onHoldChange;
      }, [onHoldChange]);
    
      const setSelectedDate = useCallback((date: string | null) => {
        dispatch({ type: "SET_DATE", date });
      }, []);
    
      const setSelectedEndDate = useCallback((date: string | null) => {
        dispatch({ type: "SET_END_DATE", date });
      }, []);
    
      const setPartySize = useCallback((size: number) => {
        dispatch({ type: "SET_PARTY_SIZE", size });
      }, []);
    
      // Fetch available time slots for the currently selected date/party size.
      // Owned here (not the component) so it can be driven headlessly and reused
      // by both goToTimeSlot and the hold-expiry timer below.
      // Slots come from the slug-scoped public route: the widget's api client is
      // tokenless, so the staff /api/v1/availability route would 401 every guest.
      // goToTimeSlot reports the missing-slug dead end before calling this, so the
      // slug guard is just for the type.
      const fetchSlots = useCallback(async (): Promise<SlotListing> => {
        if (!flowState.data.selectedDate || !venueSlug) return { slots: [] };
        const response = await api.availability.getPublicAvailability(venueSlug, {
          date: flowState.data.selectedDate,
          partySize: flowState.data.partySize,
        });
        return {
          slots: response.data.filter((slot) => slot.available),
          closure: response.closure,
          bookingPaused: response.bookingPaused,
        };
      }, [api, venueSlug, flowState.data.selectedDate, flowState.data.partySize]);
    
      // Release a hold by ID — errors are ignored, the hold expires anyway.
      // Goes through the slug-scoped public route (#4487); a hold can only exist
      // when venueSlug is set, so the guard is just for the type.
      const releaseHold = useCallback(
        async (holdId: string) => {
          if (!venueSlug) return;
          try {
            await api.holds.releaseForVenue(venueSlug, holdId);
          } catch {
            // Ignore — hold expires anyway
          }
        },
        [api, venueSlug]
      );
    
      // Guest-risk lookup — owned here (not the component) so the risk-gated
      // deposit override is exercisable headlessly through this hook alone.
      const fetchGuestRisk = useCallback(
        async (email?: string, phone?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
          if (!venueSlug || (!email && !phone)) return false;
          try {
            const result = await api.publicVenue.guestRisk(venueSlug, email ? { email } : { phone });
            return result.requiresDeposit;
          } catch {
            return false;
          }
        },
        [api, venueSlug]
      );
    
      // Fetch the venue's public deposit config once, when venueSlug is present.
      // Owned here (not the component) so it's exercisable headlessly.
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!venueSlug) return;
    
        const fetchDepositConfig = async () => {
          try {
            const venueConfig = await api.venues.getPublicConfig(venueSlug);
            // Stored in full (not just the deposit portion) so ConfirmationView
            // can thread name/ianaTimezone through for "Add to calendar" — set
            // unconditionally, unlike the deposit config below.
            dispatch({ type: "SET_VENUE_CONFIG", config: venueConfig });
            // Gate on whether a deposit was ever configured (amountCents
            // present), not on the venue's general `.enabled` flag — a venue
            // that configured then disabled its general policy must still
            // surface its deposit terms so the risky-guest override in
            // effectiveDepositPolicy can apply them. A venue that never
            // configured a deposit at all (amountCents null) leaves
            // depositConfig null, same as before.
            if (venueConfig.deposit.amountCents != null) {
              const config: DepositConfig = {
                enabled: venueConfig.deposit.enabled,
                depositType: venueConfig.deposit.depositType ?? "flat",
                amountCents: venueConfig.deposit.amountCents,
                currency: venueConfig.currencyCode.toLowerCase(),
                freeCancellationHours: venueConfig.deposit.freeCancellationHours,
                lateCancellationFeePercent: venueConfig.deposit.lateCancellationFeePercent,
                noShowFeePercent: venueConfig.deposit.noShowFeePercent,
              };
              dispatch({
                type: "SET_DEPOSIT_CONFIG",
                config,
                depositRequired: provisionalDepositRequired(config, venueSlug, stripePublishableKey),
              });
            }
          } catch {
            // Non-fatal — proceed without deposit
          }
        };
    
        fetchDepositConfig();
      }, [venueSlug, stripePublishableKey, api]);
    
      // Closed dates for the booking window, fetched once so the calendar can
      // disable and name them before a guest picks one. A failure is non-fatal:
      // the per-date listing still reports a closure when a date is opened.
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!venueSlug) return;
        const from = venueDate(new Date(), venueTimezone);
        api.availability
          .getClosedDates(venueSlug, { from, to: addDays(from, CLOSED_DATES_LOOKAHEAD_DAYS) })
          .then((dates) =>
            dispatch({
              type: "SET_CLOSED_DATES",
              closures: Object.fromEntries(dates.map(({ date, closure }) => [date, closure.message])),
            })
          )
          .catch(() => undefined);
      }, [api, venueSlug, venueTimezone]);
    
      const goToTimeSlot = useCallback(() => {
        const holdId = flowState.data.hold?.id;
        if (holdId) {
          releaseHold(holdId);
        }
        dispatch({ type: "GO_TO_TIME_SLOT" });
        if (!venueSlug) {
          dispatch({ type: "SET_SLOTS_ERROR", error: i18n.t("bookingWidget.errors.missingVenueSlug") });
          return;
        }
        fetchSlots()
          .then((listing) => dispatch({ type: "SET_SLOTS", listing }))
          .catch((err: unknown) => {
            dispatch({ type: "SET_SLOTS_ERROR", error: describeApiError(err).detail });
          });
      }, [flowState.data.hold, releaseHold, fetchSlots, venueSlug, i18n]);
    
      const goToDateParty = useCallback(() => {
        const holdId = flowState.data.hold?.id;
        if (holdId) {
          releaseHold(holdId);
        }
        dispatch({ type: "GO_TO_DATE_PARTY" });
      }, [flowState.data.hold, releaseHold]);
    
      const selectSlotAndHold = useCallback(
        async (slot: TimeSlot): Promise<void> => {
          if (!flowState.data.selectedDate) return;
          dispatch({ type: "HOLD_START", slot });
          if (!venueSlug) {
            dispatch({ type: "HOLD_ERROR", error: i18n.t("bookingWidget.errors.missingVenueSlug") });
            return;
          }
          try {
            // Slug-scoped public route (#4487): the server resolves the venue from
            // the slug and derives the hold's end time and duration from the
            // venue's own settings, so neither is sent from here.
            const { hold } = await api.holds.createForVenue(venueSlug, {
              date: flowState.data.selectedDate,
              startTime: slot.time,
              partySize: flowState.data.partySize,
            });
            dispatch({ type: "HOLD_SUCCESS", hold, slot });
          } catch (err) {
            dispatch({ type: "HOLD_ERROR", error: describeApiError(err).detail });
          }
        },
        [api, venueSlug, flowState.data.selectedDate, flowState.data.partySize, i18n]
      );
    
      const confirmReservation = useCallback(
        async (details: GuestDetails): Promise<void> => {
          // A hold can only exist when venueSlug is set (selectSlotAndHold refuses
          // otherwise), so the slug guard here is just for the type.
          if (!flowState.data.hold || !venueSlug) return;
    
          // Only check guest risk when it could actually change the verdict
          // (guestRiskMatters — the shared deposit-verdict module's own gating)
          // — avoids an unnecessary lookup, and avoids sending guest PII
          // (email/phone) when there's no deposit flow to gate.
          const guestIsRisky = guestRiskMatters(
            flowState.data.depositConfig,
            venueSlug,
            stripePublishableKey
          )
            ? await fetchGuestRisk(details.email || undefined, details.phone || undefined)
            : false;
    
          const depositConfig = effectiveDepositPolicy({
            depositConfig: flowState.data.depositConfig,
            venueSlug,
            stripePublishableKey,
            guestIsRisky,
          });
    
          dispatch({ type: "CONFIRM_START" });
          try {
            const { reservation, manageToken } = await api.holds.confirmForVenue(
              venueSlug,
              flowState.data.hold.id,
              {
                guestName: details.name,
                guestEmail: details.email || undefined,
                guestPhone: details.phone || undefined,
                notes: details.notes || undefined,
              }
            );
            // `depositConfig` is the resolved output of effectiveDepositPolicy —
            // per its contract, a non-null result (which may itself carry
            // `enabled: false` on the risky-guest override path) means a deposit
            // is required. Checking `.enabled` here would silently drop that
            // override.
            if (depositConfig) {
              dispatch({
                type: "CONFIRM_SUCCESS_WITH_DEPOSIT",
                reservation,
                manageToken: manageToken ?? null,
              });
            } else {
              dispatch({
                type: "CONFIRM_SUCCESS_NO_DEPOSIT",
                reservation,
                manageToken: manageToken ?? null,
              });
            }
          } catch (err) {
            const closure = outsideAvailabilityMessage(err);
            if (closure === null) {
              dispatch({ type: "CONFIRM_ERROR", error: describeApiError(err).detail });
              return;
            }
            // A closure saved after the hold was made (ux.md F9.5): the hold is
            // dead, so release it and show what is still open that day.
            void releaseHold(flowState.data.hold.id);
            dispatch({ type: "CLOSED_MID_BOOKING", message: closure });
            fetchSlots()
              .then((listing) => dispatch({ type: "SET_SLOTS", listing }))
              .catch(() =>
                dispatch({
                  type: "SET_SLOTS_ERROR",
                  error: i18n.t("bookingWidget.errors.reloadFailed"),
                })
              );
          }
        },
        [
          api,
          releaseHold,
          fetchSlots,
          i18n,
          flowState.data.hold,
          flowState.data.depositConfig,
          venueSlug,
          stripePublishableKey,
          fetchGuestRisk,
        ]
      );
    
      const handleDepositSuccess = useCallback((paymentIntentId: string) => {
        dispatch({ type: "DEPOSIT_SUCCESS", paymentIntentId });
      }, []);
    
      const resetFlow = useCallback(() => {
        dispatch({ type: "RESET", selectedDate: venueDate(new Date(), venueTimezone) });
      }, [venueTimezone]);
    
      const goToWaitlistJoin = useCallback(() => {
        dispatch({ type: "GO_TO_WAITLIST_JOIN" });
      }, []);
    
      const handleWaitlistJoined = useCallback((result: WaitlistResult) => {
        dispatch({ type: "WAITLIST_JOINED", result });
      }, []);
    
      const setGuestDetails = useCallback((details: GuestDetails) => {
        dispatch({ type: "SET_GUEST_DETAILS", details });
      }, []);
    
      // Hold-expiry timer — captured hold in closure; effect restarts on every
      // hold change. Owned here (not the component) so expiry + availability
      // reload are exercisable headlessly through this hook alone.
      useEffect(() => {
        if (!flowState.data.hold) return undefined;
        const capturedHold = flowState.data.hold;
    
        const interval = setInterval(() => {
          if (new Date() >= new Date(capturedHold.expiresAt)) {
            dispatch({ type: "EXPIRE_HOLD", error: i18n.t("bookingWidget.errors.holdExpired") });
            fetchSlots()
              .then((listing) => dispatch({ type: "SET_SLOTS", listing }))
              .catch(() =>
                dispatch({
                  type: "SET_SLOTS_ERROR",
                  error: i18n.t("bookingWidget.errors.reloadFailed"),
                })
              );
          }
        }, 1000);
    
        return () => clearInterval(interval);
      }, [flowState.data.hold, fetchSlots, i18n]);
    
      // Notifies onHoldChange whenever the "releasable" hold changes. The reducer
      // clears `data.hold` once it becomes a reservation, so any hold left is
      // still releasable.
      const activeHoldId = flowState.data.hold?.id ?? null;
      useEffect(() => {
        onHoldChangeRef.current?.(
          activeHoldId ? { holdId: activeHoldId, sessionId: api.holds.getSessionId() } : null
        );
      }, [activeHoldId, api]);
    
      // Render-time derivation — single source of truth for the step set and
      // indicator. Both step sets share the same indices for every step before
      // "payment", so the index is always valid regardless of which set is active.
      const stepKeys = deriveStepKeys(flowState.data.depositRequired);
      const currentStepIndex = stepKeys.indexOf(flowState.step);
    
      return {
        state: flowState.step,
        data: flowState.data,
        stepKeys,
        currentStepIndex,
        actions: {
          setSelectedDate,
          setSelectedEndDate,
          setPartySize,
          goToTimeSlot,
          goToDateParty,
          selectSlotAndHold,
          confirmReservation,
          handleDepositSuccess,
          resetFlow,
          goToWaitlistJoin,
          handleWaitlistJoined,
          setGuestDetails,
        },
      };
    }
  </file>
  </section>
  <section priority="medium" role="constants">
  <file path="src/constants/auth.ts">
    export interface AuthConfigResult {
      readonly valid: true;
      readonly config: {
        readonly authority: string;
        readonly clientId: string;
        readonly redirectUri: string;
        readonly audience: string | undefined;
      };
    }
    export interface AuthConfigFailure {
      readonly valid: false;
      readonly missing: readonly string[];
    }
    export function validateAuthConfig(): AuthConfigResult | AuthConfigFailure {
      const missing = REQUIRED_AUTH_ENV.filter((env) => !env.value || env.value.trim() === "").map(
        (env) => env.key
      );
    
      if (missing.length > 0) {
        return { valid: false, missing };
      }
    
      return {
        valid: true,
        config: {
          authority: import.meta.env.VITE_AUTH_AUTHORITY,
          clientId: import.meta.env.VITE_AUTH_CLIENT_ID,
          redirectUri:
            import.meta.env.VITE_AUTH_REDIRECT_URI || window.location.origin + "/hospitality/callback",
          audience: import.meta.env.VITE_AUTH_AUDIENCE || undefined,
        },
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/constants/copilotContext.ts">
    export const HOSPITALITY_DOMAIN_CONTEXT: DomainContext = {
      schemas: [
        {
          name: "Reservation",
          description: "A dining reservation linked to a table and guest.",
          fields:
            "id, guestName, tableId, partySize, date, time, status (pending|confirmed|cancelled|seated|completed), notes",
        },
        {
          name: "FloorPlan",
          description: "A restaurant floor layout with named zones and table positions.",
          fields:
            "id, name, tables (id, label, x, y, width, height, capacity, shape, zoneId), zones (id, name, color)",
        },
        {
          name: "Guest",
          description: "A guest profile with visit history and preferences.",
          fields: "id, name, email, phone, visitCount, lastVisit, preferences, notes",
        },
      ],
    };
    interface ChatVenue {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly ianaTimezone: string;
    }
    export function chatRequestContext(venue: ChatVenue | null | undefined): Record<string, string> {
      if (!venue) return {};
      const timeZone = resolveTimeZone(venue.ianaTimezone);
      return timeZone ? { venueId: venue.id, timeZone } : { venueId: venue.id };
    }
    export function useChatRequestContext(): Record<string, string> {
      const { selectedVenue } = useVenue();
      return useMemo(() => chatRequestContext(selectedVenue), [selectedVenue]);
    }
    export function useChatSuggestions(): readonly string[] {
      const { t } = useTranslation();
      return useMemo(
        () => [
          t("chat.suggestions.tonight"),
          t("chat.suggestions.openTables"),
          t("chat.suggestions.availability"),
          t("chat.suggestions.walkIn"),
        ],
        [t]
      );
    }
    type ChatActionKey =
      | (typeof ACTION_TITLES)[keyof typeof ACTION_TITLES]
      | (typeof ACTION_FIELDS)[keyof typeof ACTION_FIELDS]
      | (typeof TABLE_STATUSES)[keyof typeof TABLE_STATUSES];
    type Translate = (key: ChatActionKey) => string;
    function formatWhen(key: string, value: string, locale?: string): string {
      if (key === "date" && CALENDAR_DATE.test(value) && isRealDate(value)) {
        return formatCalendarDate(value, { weekday: "long", month: "short", day: "numeric" }, locale);
      }
      if (TIME_FIELDS.has(key) && WALL_TIME.test(value)) return formatLocalTime(value, locale);
      return value;
    }
    function lookup<T extends Record<string, string>>(map: T, key: string): T[keyof T] | undefined {
      return Object.hasOwn(map, key) ? map[key as keyof T] : undefined;
    }
    export function describeChatAction(
      action: PendingAction,
      t: Translate,
      tableName: (id: string) => string | undefined,
      locale?: string
    ): ActionDescription {
      const titleKey = lookup(ACTION_TITLES, action.toolName);
      return {
        title: titleKey ? t(titleKey) : action.toolName.replace(/_/g, " "),
        details: Object.entries(action.toolInput).map(([key, raw]) => {
          const value = String(raw);
          const statusKey = key === "status" ? lookup(TABLE_STATUSES, value) : undefined;
          const shown =
            key === "tableId"
              ? (tableName(value) ?? value)
              : statusKey
                ? t(statusKey)
                : formatWhen(key, value, locale);
          const labelKey = lookup(ACTION_FIELDS, key);
          return { label: labelKey ? t(labelKey) : key, value: shown };
        }),
      };
    }
    export function useDescribeChatAction(): (action: PendingAction) => ActionDescription {
      const { t, i18n } = useTranslation();
      const { selectedVenue } = useVenue();
      const { data: tables } = useTables({
        venueId: selectedVenue?.id ?? "",
        limit: 100,
        enabled: Boolean(selectedVenue),
      });
      return useCallback(
        (action: PendingAction) =>
          describeChatAction(
            action,
            t,
            (id) => tables?.find((table) => table.id === id)?.name,
            i18n.language
          ),
        [t, tables, i18n.language]
      );
    }
